human_contribution: Ingolf Lohmann: require self-application, exact-subject closure and SUCCESS != EFFECT.
artificial_cognitive_contribution: ChatGPT: identified the workflow-success/effect conflation and absent post-write readback; implemented the bounded repair and synthetic execution regressions.
closure_scope: Bot-owned GitHub comment projection only; not causal review-ledger completion or external deployment effect.
closure_rule: Workflow success remains OBSERVE. After one projection write, one separate GET must match comment ID, exact body, PR issue URL and github-actions[bot] author. Mismatch or API failure stops without retry or a completion claim.

preparation_evidence.method: Actual workflow shell with local gh fixtures and jq
